profile.headline: Software Developer I @ General Atomics ASI

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
• Refactored and optimized embedded software in C for ARM-based microcontrollers running RTOS, improving
GPIO configuration and communication protocols to achieve a 15% reduction in response time.
• Debugged C++ firmware and low-level device drivers for sensors interfaced via UART, SPI, and I2C,
troubleshooting hardware and software issues to ensure accurate and low-latency data transmission.
• Evaluated schematics and custom hardware prototypes throughout the product development life cycle using
breadboards, oscilloscopes, multimeters, and soldering, to support iterative design and PCB revisions.
• Automated multi-sensor data collection, processing, and visualization using Python, streamlining retrieval and
analysis by applying problem-solving skills and replacing a manual workflow.
positions.insights: Embedded Software, Embedded Devices and +6 skills
